architectural_decisions.rationale: The platform is a web service that follows the client-server architecture, and for the client-server model, a 3-layer architecture is used, where the system is divided into 3 layers: the presentation layer, the business layer, and the data layer.

The only component that interacts directly with the presentation layer is the Api Gateway module. This is because the Api Gateway microservices design pattern is followed. This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform. The use of this pattern provides several advantages to the system, such as: It increases the security of the system by reducing the gateways to the outside, since the only way to interact with the microservices is through the Api Gateway.

AWS is the set of cloud computing services that allows the creation of scalable and highly available applications. It has been decided to use AWS and not other cloud services due to its low price and its previous use by the company.
NestJS framework has been used to develop the different services. This framework allows the creation of a secure and complex REST API in an easier way than using NodeJS directly.
TypeScript has been chosen, and not JavaScript, because it is the default language for NestJS and because thanks to its static typing it allows the detection of errors at compile time.
The objective of these services is to form a data lake where all history is stored to be able to process them in the analytical module.

Amazon Athena is a serverless service, which means it is not necessary to manage the infrastructure when there is an increase in the set of data and users. In addition, to obtain data quickly, Athena performs queries in parallel.
To make the data transmission as fast as possible, two Amazon services have been used, which allow us to perform a transmission in near real-time.
